Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status and now sits cleanly at the preferred level:

- Removed the diluting extras ("consistent with industry standards", "in all material respects to its then-current documentation and specifications", vendor-elected "at TrueLink's option").
- Made conformance express and unqualified for the Interface, related software and deliverables (12 months) and added the missing express **90 days** Services conformance period (digit-first, as the literal check requires).
- Retained the malicious-code and compliance-with-laws limbs and a Client-side repair/replacement/refund remedy, with no added defence, survival or settlement boilerplate.

All official precision and minimality checks return ok:true, and each of the eleven preferred elements maps once to the single insert after p0060 (the last body paragraph of Section 9).
